privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Delta SPMU Academy ('we', 'us', 'our') is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal information.
privacy.collection_text: We collect information you provide when registering, enrolling in courses, or making payments. This includes your name, email address, phone number, and payment details.
privacy.usage_text: We use your information to provide educational services, process payments, issue certificates, communicate course updates, and improve our platform.
privacy.sharing_text: We do not sell your personal information. We may share data with payment processors (telebirr, Chapa, EthSwitch) to complete transactions and with email providers to send notifications.
privacy.security_text: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data, including encrypted connections, secure server infrastructure, and restricted access to personal information.
privacy.rights_text: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us or through your account settings.
privacy.contact_text: For privacy inquiries, contact us at privacy@deltaspmu.com.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service govern your use of the Delta SPMU Academy e-learning platform.
terms.accounts_text: You must be at least 18 years old to create an account. You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account credentials.
terms.courses_text: Course access is granted for 30 days from the date of purchase. Access may be extended through additional purchases. Course content is for personal educational use only.
terms.payments_text: All prices are listed in Ethiopian Birr (ETB) unless otherwise stated. Payments are processed through our authorized payment providers.
terms.ip_text: All course content, materials, videos, and resources are the intellectual property of Delta SPMU Academy. Unauthorized reproduction, distribution, or sharing of materials is prohibited.
terms.conduct_text: Students are expected to maintain professional behavior and respect towards instructors, fellow students, and staff. Violations may result in account suspension.
terms.termination_text: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.intro: Delta SPMU Academy strives to ensure student satisfaction with our training programs.
refund.eligibility_text: Refund requests must be made within 7 days of purchase. Refunds are not available after course content has been substantially accessed (more than 25% of lessons viewed).
refund.process_text: To request a refund, contact us at support@deltaspmu.com with your transaction ID and reason for the request. Refunds are processed within 5-10 business days.
refund.exceptions_text: Bundle purchases, promotional offers, and courses where a certificate has been issued are not eligible for refund.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: Delta SPMU Academy uses cookies to enhance your learning experience.
cookies.what_text: Cookies are small files stored on your device that help us remember your preferences and provide a better experience.
cookies.essential: Essential Cookies: Required for platform functionality, authentication, and security.
cookies.functional: Functional Cookies: Remember your language preference and learning progress.
cookies.analytics: Analytics Cookies: Help us understand how you use the platform to improve our services.
cookies.manage_text: You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings. Disabling essential cookies may affect platform functionality.
